context.title: Load candidates and authority
context.imperative: Read the handed-in candidates (cartographer findings, review findings, plans, execute.json triage_candidates) and the issue authority in docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md. Attest c1.

classify.title: Classify candidates
classify.imperative: Classify each candidate (bug, cleanup, missing test/doc, architecture weakness, ...). Preserve structural anchor, current truth, future concern, evidence.

write.title: Write recommendations
write.imperative: Write an issue-ready recommendation per candidate (what, importance, evidence, acceptance criteria, out of scope). Create issues where authority allows; otherwise recommend and ask.
